# Meritus

> India's AI-powered all-exam prep platform for JEE, NEET, UPSC, Banking, GATE, CAT and 200+ competitive exams.

Meritus combines pixel-perfect NTA-style mock tests, an Ebbinghaus-curve "Forget-Meter" for spaced repetition, an AI tutor, AI-generated study plans, and 1-on-1 mentor sessions with toppers.
